answer_1.quote: Generating texts to describe images (a.k.a., image captioning) has many real-world applications...
answer_1.outputs: image captions in target language (e.g., Chinese or English)

answer_2.quote: Following baselines, we report the BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE and CIDEr scores for model evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We ask ten native Chinese speakers to score the results. And for each result, we use the averaged scores.
answer_4.guideline: We design a Likert 10-scale to measure the relevancy, diversification, and fluency of the generated target-side captions... Wording: Is the choice of words in the captions suitable and precise to describe the input images? Word order: Are the words, phrases, and components organized correctly and properly in captioning sentences? Syntax correctness: Are there syntactic errors in the caption texts?
